reference_sql:
WITH store_sales AS (
  -- one row per store, product and UTC day with store sales from 1 to 28 December 2024
  SELECT o.store_id, ol.product_id, CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) AS sale_date, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN order_lines AS ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.channel = 'store'
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-12-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2024-12-29 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY o.store_id, ol.product_id, CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE)
),
stock_days AS (
  -- one row per store, product and day of the window, with that day's units sold (0 when none)
  SELECT i.store_id, i.product_id, i.snapshot_date, i.units_on_hand, COALESCE(s.units, 0) AS units
  FROM inventory_chain_daily AS i
  LEFT JOIN store_sales AS s
    ON s.store_id = i.store_id AND s.product_id = i.product_id AND s.sale_date = i.snapshot_date
  WHERE i.snapshot_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-28'
),
rates AS (
  -- one row per store and product: its in-stock days and its weekly rate over them
  SELECT store_id, product_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN units_on_hand > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_stock_days,
         7.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN units_on_hand > 0 THEN units ELSE 0 END)
           / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN units_on_hand > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS weekly_units
  FROM stock_days
  GROUP BY store_id, product_id
)
SELECT c.store_id, c.product_id, c.units_on_hand, r.in_stock_days,
       ROUND(r.weekly_units, 2) AS avg_weekly_units,
       ROUND(c.units_on_hand / r.weekly_units, 1) AS weeks_cover
FROM inventory_chain_daily AS c
JOIN rates AS r ON r.store_id = c.store_id AND r.product_id = c.product_id
WHERE c.snapshot_date = DATE '2024-12-29'
  AND r.weekly_units > 0
  AND c.units_on_hand / r.weekly_units < 2
ORDER BY c.store_id, c.product_id

WITH daily_units AS (
  -- one row per store, product and UTC day with store sales from 1 to 28 December 2024
  SELECT st.store_id, s.product_id, s.order_date, SUM(s.units) AS units
  FROM sales AS s
  JOIN stores AS st ON st.store_code = s.store_code
  WHERE s.channel = 'store'
    AND s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-28'
  GROUP BY st.store_id, s.product_id, s.order_date
),
pair_days AS (
  -- one row per store, product and calendar day of the window
  SELECT p.store_id, p.product_id, c.cal_date
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT store_id, product_id FROM inventory_chain_daily) AS p
  CROSS JOIN calendar AS c
  WHERE c.cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-28'
),
filled AS (
  -- one row per store, product and day of the window: closing stock and units sold (0 when none)
  SELECT d.store_id, d.product_id, d.cal_date, i.units_on_hand, COALESCE(u.units, 0) AS units
  FROM pair_days AS d
  LEFT JOIN inventory_chain_daily AS i
    ON i.store_id = d.store_id AND i.product_id = d.product_id AND i.snapshot_date = d.cal_date
  LEFT JOIN daily_units AS u
    ON u.store_id = d.store_id AND u.product_id = d.product_id AND u.order_date = d.cal_date
),
rates AS (
  -- one row per store and product with at least one in-stock day
  SELECT store_id, product_id,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE units_on_hand > 0) AS in_stock_days,
         SUM(units) FILTER (WHERE units_on_hand > 0) AS in_stock_units
  FROM filled
  GROUP BY store_id, product_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE units_on_hand > 0) > 0
),
cover AS (
  -- one row per store and product that sold on its in-stock days, with its stock on 29 December 2024
  SELECT r.store_id, r.product_id, i.units_on_hand, r.in_stock_days,
         7.0 * r.in_stock_units / r.in_stock_days AS weekly_units
  FROM rates AS r
  JOIN inventory_chain_daily AS i
    ON i.store_id = r.store_id AND i.product_id = r.product_id AND i.snapshot_date = DATE '2024-12-29'
  WHERE r.in_stock_units > 0
)
SELECT store_id, product_id, units_on_hand, in_stock_days,
       ROUND(weekly_units, 2) AS avg_weekly_units,
       ROUND(units_on_hand / weekly_units, 1) AS weeks_cover
FROM cover
WHERE units_on_hand / weekly_units < 2
ORDER BY store_id, product_id

WITH store_sales AS (
  -- one row per store, product and UTC day with store sales from 1 to 28 December 2024
  SELECT o.store_id, ol.product_id, CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) AS sale_date, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN order_lines AS ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.channel = 'store'
    AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-28'
  GROUP BY o.store_id, ol.product_id, CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE)
),
pairs AS (
  -- one row per store and product: the window's in-stock days and units, and the stock on 29 December 2024
  SELECT i.store_id, i.product_id,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.snapshot_date <= DATE '2024-12-28' AND i.units_on_hand > 0) AS in_stock_days,
         COALESCE(SUM(s.units) FILTER (WHERE i.snapshot_date <= DATE '2024-12-28' AND i.units_on_hand > 0), 0) AS in_stock_units,
         MAX(CASE WHEN i.snapshot_date = DATE '2024-12-29' THEN i.units_on_hand END) AS units_on_hand
  FROM inventory_chain_daily AS i
  LEFT JOIN store_sales AS s
    ON s.store_id = i.store_id AND s.product_id = i.product_id AND s.sale_date = i.snapshot_date
  WHERE i.snapshot_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-29'
  GROUP BY i.store_id, i.product_id
)
SELECT store_id, product_id, units_on_hand, in_stock_days,
       ROUND(7.0 * in_stock_units / in_stock_days, 2) AS avg_weekly_units,
       ROUND(units_on_hand / (7.0 * in_stock_units / in_stock_days), 1) AS weeks_cover
FROM pairs
WHERE in_stock_days > 0
  AND in_stock_units > 0
  AND units_on_hand / (7.0 * in_stock_units / in_stock_days) < 2
ORDER BY store_id, product_id

other_way.tradeoff: A calendar spine crossed with every pair keeps each day even without a stock row, but it reads more tables than the stock rows need.

solver.query:
WITH stock AS (
  SELECT store_id, product_id,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE units_on_hand > 0 AND snapshot_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-28') AS in_days,
         MAX(units_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE snapshot_date = DATE '2024-12-29') AS on_hand
  FROM inventory_chain_daily
  GROUP BY store_id, product_id
),
daily AS (
  SELECT o.store_id, l.product_id, CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) AS d, SUM(l.quantity) AS u
  FROM orders o JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.channel = 'store' AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-28'
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
inst AS (
  SELECT d.store_id, d.product_id, SUM(d.u) AS u_in, SUM(d.u) FILTER (WHERE TRUE) AS dummy
  FROM daily d
  JOIN inventory_chain_daily i ON i.store_id = d.store_id AND i.product_id = d.product_id
       AND i.snapshot_date = d.d AND i.units_on_hand > 0
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
alld AS (SELECT store_id, product_id, SUM(u) AS u_all FROM daily GROUP BY 1, 2),
p AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, s.product_id, s.on_hand, s.in_days, i.u_in, COALESCE(a.u_all, 0) AS u_all,
         7.0 * i.u_in / s.in_days AS rate
  FROM stock s
  JOIN inst i ON i.store_id = s.store_id AND i.product_id = s.product_id
  LEFT JOIN alld a ON a.store_id = s.store_id AND a.product_id = s.product_id
  WHERE s.in_days > 0 AND s.on_hand IS NOT NULL AND i.u_in > 0
)
SELECT store_id, product_id, on_hand AS units_on_hand, in_days AS in_stock_days,
       ROUND(rate, 2) AS avg_weekly_units, ROUND(on_hand / rate, 1) AS weeks_cover
FROM p
WHERE on_hand / rate < 2
ORDER BY store_id, product_id
